items.definition:
a short, popular, and memorable saying that expresses some general truth or useful thought
My grandmother always had a wise saying for every situation.

a person or device that selects
The team selector had a difficult job choosing the final squad.

a piece of fabric worn over the shoulders or head
She draped a colorful shawl over her shoulders to keep warm.

a person from Slovakia; the Slovak language
He is a Slovak who speaks both Slovak and English fluently.

a Dravidian language spoken in India
Many people in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana speak Telugu.

a frankfurter or hot dog
We roasted wieners over the campfire for dinner.

aunt (informal)
My aunty always bakes delicious cookies.

a card game
We played a few hands of blackjack at the casino.

camouflage (informal)
He wore a jacket with a camo pattern.

a person who looks after a sick, elderly, or disabled person
She works as a professional carer for the elderly.

an activity involving organized routines of jumps, dance, and shouts
My sister joined the cheerleading squad.

a common household insect
I saw a cockroach scuttling across the kitchen floor.

a cosmetic applied to the eyelids to emphasize the eyes
She applied black eyeliner to her upper lash line.

a short story, typically with animals as characters, conveying a moral
The tortoise and the hare is a famous fable.

a low hill at the base of a mountain or mountain range
Their house is nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains.

U-shaped metal plate for a horse's hoof
The blacksmith fitted a new horseshoe onto the horse's hoof.

a small shelter for a dog
The dog slept soundly in its kennel.

a type of beer
He ordered a pint of cold lager.

the act of renovating or changing the structure of something
The kitchen remodeling project took longer than expected.

a person who pays for the use of something
The renter signed a new lease agreement for the apartment.

a man who takes part in sports
He is a true sportsman, always playing fair.

a small child; a small amount of an alcoholic drink
The little tot was playing with her toys.

a path or passage for walking
The new walkway connects the two buildings.

a building with sails that turn in the wind and generate power
The old windmill stood proudly on the hill.

a person who conducts auctions
The auctioneer called out the bids quickly.

either of the two fleshy parts of the human body that form the lower back part of the trunk
He landed hard on his buttock after slipping on the ice.

a unit of weight for precious stones, especially diamonds
She wore a ring with a two-carat diamond.

the salted roe of sturgeon or other large fish, eaten as a delicacy
They served champagne and caviar at the reception.

a person chosen to preside over a meeting or committee
The chairperson opened the meeting by reviewing the agenda.

light rain falling in very fine drops
A light drizzle began to fall as we left the house.

football (informal)
Let's go play some footy in the park.

a person who gambles
The professional gambler always played with a strategy.

gentleman (informal)
He's a real gent, always opening doors for people.

a sudden strong rush of wind
A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.

a puzzle consisting of a picture cut into irregular pieces
We spent the afternoon putting together a 1000-piece jigsaw.

a carnivorous mammal or its valuable fur
The mink coat was very expensive.

the area in a newspaper or broadcasting office where news is prepared
The journalists worked late in the newsroom to meet the deadline.

social activities or entertainment available at night
London is famous for its vibrant nightlife.

a small, mythical creature, often mischievous
The children believed a pixie lived at the bottom of their garden.

a person who has retired from work
The community center offers special programs for retirees.

an amusement park ride with steep inclines and descents
The children screamed with delight on the rollercoaster.

a saxophone
He plays the sax in a jazz band.

Aquatic invertebrates with shells
Many people are allergic to shellfish.

The sport or activity of riding a skateboard
Skateboarding is a popular street sport.

The sport of descending a snow-covered slope on a snowboard
Snowboarding is an exciting winter sport.

The state of being unhappy
Her unhappiness was evident in her expression.

the practice of strengthening and enlarging the muscles of the body through exercise
He spends hours in the gym, dedicated to bodybuilding.

a sound made by a bell or set of bells
The clock struck noon with a gentle chime.

the state of being near or intimate
Their closeness as siblings was evident to everyone.

a puzzle consisting of a grid of squares and blanks into which words are entered
She enjoys doing the crossword puzzle every morning.

a migratory bird with a characteristic two-note call
We heard the cuckoo's distinctive call from the woods.

a cosmetic applied to the eyelids
She applied blue eyeshadow to her eyelids.

a favorite person or thing
That song is my new fave.

affection or liking for someone or something
She had a great fondness for old books.

A person from Ghana
The Ghanaian ambassador spoke at the conference.

A bed made of canvas or rope netting, suspended by cords at the ends
She spent the afternoon reading in the hammock under the trees.

an item of content published online; a job vacancy
She saw an interesting job posting on the company's website.

a room used for displaying goods for sale
We visited the car showroom to see the new models.

a person who claims or uses magical powers; a wizard
The sorcerer cast a powerful spell.

the use of magic, especially black magic
The villagers believed the old woman practiced sorcery.

an area of expertise or a particular skill
Italian cuisine is his speciality.

the light emitted by stars
We sat under the starlight, enjoying the quiet night.

a strong fabric sheet connected by springs to a frame, used for acrobatic jumping
The children loved jumping on the trampoline.

a nocturnal beetle with a light-producing organ
We watched the fireflies glow in the evening.
